caption: The drawing depicts a carved stone or relief featuring a bird of prey, likely an eagle, shown with its wings raised and spread upwards. The bird's head is lowered, and its beak is slightly open, grasping a branch with leaves and berries in its talons. The feathers on the wings and body are detailed with fine lines, and the branch lies across the lower portion of the relief. The image is rendered in monochromatic tones of gray and brown, giving it a stone-like and textured appearance. The background of the carved relief has a patterned or stippled texture, and the relief itself appears rectangular with irregular, slightly broken edges. Two signatures, reading "Richard Barnett," are visible—one near the lower right of the relief and another at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Carved Keystone
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
